subject: english
stem: This talk happens while both speakers have time to make a change. What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: a request to move the book cartons to the science room
an offer to store the book cartons in the bookstore
a question about when the book cartons arrived at the bookstore
a request to move the book cartons to the bookstore

optionRationales.reason: a request to move the book cartons to the science room：此項把「bookstore」改成「science room」。整段對話的主要功能為「a request to move the book cartons to the bookstore」。因此，鎖定證據支持「a request to move the book cartons to the bookstore」。

an offer to store the book cartons in the bookstore：此項把「a request to move the book cartons to」改成「an offer to store the book cartons in」。整段對話的主要功能為「a request to move the book cartons to the bookstore」。因此，鎖定證據支持「a request to move the book cartons to the bookstore」。

a question about when the book cartons arrived at the bookstore：此項把「request to move the book cartons to」改成「question about when the book cartons arrived at」。整段對話的主要功能為「a request to move the book cartons to the bookstore」。因此，鎖定證據支持「a request to move the book cartons to the bookstore」。
a request to move the book cartons to the bookstore：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。整段對話的主要功能為「a request to move the book cartons to the bookstore」。
